title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.1.1 RC2
summary: Smoother computer matrix rendering and immediate dragging, retaining RC1 transfer recovery fixes.
changes: Render monitor artwork and status together on one double-buffered matrix surface.
Keep native editable computer names and checkboxes with their existing behavior.
Arrange the matrix before the first visible frame and update connection status atomically.
Use pointer capture with immediate target swaps in one/two rows; cancel on Escape, right click, lost capture or release outside the matrix.
Retain RC1 transfer recovery fixes; mouse sharing and network transport are unchanged.
testing: Windows Release x64 build and automated regression suite must pass before publication.
Test opening Machine Setup, fast dragging, one/two rows, cancellation, name editing and Apply/reopen.
Real-PC rendering at your display scale still needs owner testing.
known_limitations: One self-contained, unsigned Windows x64 EXE; no Windows service or protected-desktop support.
Full-speed copies can still compete with mouse sharing on busy Wi-Fi.
Folder copies can partially complete. Unsupported links and unreadable directories require a fresh drag.
Recovery records now include compact receipts; keep backups and avoid downgrading while transfers are unfinished.
